screen: Impact Platform — how it works
spoken: Impact Platform: how it works. A walkthrough in two parts. First, setting up an organisation. Second, the measurement cycle. All data shown is synthetic test data on a local test instance.

screen: One rule explains most of the steps
spoken: One rule explains most of the steps. Nobody can approve their own work. Every approval — of an organisation, a data entry, a report — is made by a different person. That is what makes the numbers trustworthy.

screen: Part 1 — Setting up an organisation

screen: Nakul signs in as a platform operator (test account 'admin').
spoken: Nakul signs in as a platform operator, using the test account admin.

screen: Organisations are set up in the Tenant lifecycle console, linked at the bottom of the left-hand menu.

screen: Part 2 — The measurement cycle
spoken: Part two: the measurement cycle. Inside an organisation that is already running: entering data, independent approval, calculation, closing the quarter, the dashboard and the report. Two people do the day-to-day work: a data author and an independent reviewer.

screen: The data author signs in (test account 'author').
